papers.title: Event-Centric Memory with Query-Aware Graph Augmentation for Long-Term Conversational Agents
papers.summary: Proposes QGMem, which organizes dialogue history into event-indexed memory units consolidated into traces, then uses hybrid retrieval with query-aware reranking to build a compact working memory. The working memory is encoded as a local graph token passed to the LLM, improving multi-hop reasoning and conflict resolution across six benchmarks.

papers.title: Caught in the Act: Probes Effectively Detect Sabotage and Catch Unverbalized Deception
papers.summary: Trains white-box probes on FIBS, the largest deception dataset to date, using an architecture that aggregates across layers and tokens. The probes reach 98.8% AUC on SHADE-Arena sabotage, beat a text-monitor baseline, and improve with model scale, while also detecting introspective deception.
